meaningEnglish: A friendly and informal greeting used to say hello.
meaningOriginal: नमस्ते एक सम्मानजनक और दोस्ताना अभिवादन शब्द है।
contextExplanation: Widely used in daily informal conversations to initiate friendly dialogue.
usageExplanation: Say 'Hi' when meeting friends or acquaintances. Example: 'Hi, how are you today?'

meaningEnglish: A standard and polite greeting used to say hello.
meaningOriginal: नमस्ते एक मानक और शिष्ट अभिवादन शब्द है।
contextExplanation: Suitable for both formal and informal introductions.
usageExplanation: Used globally to greet anyone. Example: 'Hello, welcome to Smart Vision!'

meaningEnglish: An expression of gratitude and appreciation.
meaningOriginal: धन्यवाद आभार और कृतज्ञता प्रकट करने का एक शिष्ट शब्द है।
contextExplanation: A crucial conversational pillar to show appreciation for help or gifts.
usageExplanation: Used when receiving assistance, a favor, or a compliment. Example: 'Thank you for your help.'

meaningEnglish: A polite word used to make requests or ask for favors.
meaningOriginal: कृपया विनम्रतापूर्वक अनुरोध या सहायता मांगने का एक शिष्ट शब्द है।
contextExplanation: Adds politeness and soft intent to imperative demands.
usageExplanation: Add 'please' at the beginning or end of requests. Example: 'Please open the door.'

meaningEnglish: A parting phrase used when taking leave or separating.
meaningOriginal: अलविदा विदा लेते समय या अलग होते समय बोला जाने वाला एक पारंपरिक शब्द है।
contextExplanation: Standard valediction marking the conclusion of a conversation.
usageExplanation: Said when ending a visit or meeting. Example: 'Goodbye, see you tomorrow!'

meaningEnglish: A friendly greeting or response to thank you.
meaningOriginal: स्वागत है किसी का शिष्टता से स्वागत करने या धन्यवाद का उत्तर देने का शब्द।
contextExplanation: Hospitality indicator or standard politeness loop.
usageExplanation: Said when welcoming guests or responding to thanks. Example: 'Welcome, make yourself at home!'

meaningEnglish: An inquiry into someone's well-being and health.
meaningOriginal: आप कैसे हैं किसी के स्वास्थ्य और कल्याण के बारे में शिष्टता से पूछना।
contextExplanation: Standard social icebreaker utilized after greetings.
usageExplanation: Ask to show care or keep conversations flowing. Example: 'How are you today?'

meaningEnglish: An urgent medical inquiry seeking location guidance.
meaningOriginal: अस्पताल कहाँ है आपातकालीन चिकित्सा दिशा-निर्देश या स्थान पूछना।
contextExplanation: Critical travel or medical phrase used in emergencies.
usageExplanation: Used to ask bystanders for the nearest clinic. Example: 'Excuse me, where is the hospital?'

meaningEnglish: An educational request asking to resolve mathematical parameters.
meaningOriginal: समीकरण को हल करें गणितीय मानों या चरणों को सुलझाने का अनुरोध।
contextExplanation: Common math, homework, or classroom instruction standard.
usageExplanation: Used in study guides, viva questions, or tutor chat requests. Example: 'Solve the equation for X.'
